Subject: Post-demo procurement preflight + portal preference (vendor paperwork)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a few procurement items so your team can route paperwork smoothly:

• Preferred commercial path: you mentioned finance historically prefers PO for platform contracts but are open to marketplace for faster time-to-value. Can you confirm which you want to pursue for Redwood?
• Vendor packet: to get a PO on file your team will need our completed vendor intake (W-9, EIN, remit info). I’ve attached a stub packet to speed internal review.
• Portal vs card: if you prefer marketplace, we can enable the marketplace listing and skip PO. If PO, expect 2–3 weeks for vendor enrollment (depending on accts-pay cadence).
• Next steps: if PO path — please share the procurement contact + onboarding form; if marketplace — confirm preferred seller listing name.

I’ve looped in Ben (go-to-market) and Jonas (partnerships) for any billing or marketplace questions.

Best,
Hannah

Hi Hannah — thanks for the follow-up and the clear checklist. Quick answers from procurement POV:

1) Commercial path: Acme prefers PO for anything over $25k ARR. This deal is expected to land under that threshold but procurement still needs vendor details for the contract. We’re leaning PO (for our tracking) but would consider marketplace if Redwood can provide a marketplace invoice pathway and a signed MSA delivered via DocuSign.

2) Required docs: please send completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) + remit/bank details + primary POC for vendor portal enrollment. Our AP team also asks for an estimated start date and sample invoice format.

3) Timeline: if you submit the packet this week, procurement can tentatively approve vendor enrollment within 6–10 business days. PO issuance follows enrollment.

I’m attaching our intake checklist for your records (referenced).

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement | Acme Payments
